headline: Learjet Crash in Palm Beach County Kills Nine
deck: Aircraft was flying from Austin to North Eleuthera after pilots reported manageable ice and turbulence; investigators have not determined why it crashed.
body: A Learjet 60 crashed in Palm Beach County, Florida, on Sunday, killing nine people, officials said. The 2004-vintage aircraft had departed Austin-Bergstrom International Airport and was bound for North Eleuthera International Airport in the Bahamas. [E1] [E2]

Before the crash, radio traffic indicated the pilots were encountering light, clear ice described as manageable, along with moderate turbulence. The pilots also requested a climb to 37,000 ft. [E3] [E4]
The pilot later reported the aircraft was in an overspeed condition and descending at 20,000 fpm. Authorities are continuing to investigate how the aircraft descended and crashed. [E5] [E6]
